subject: Discovery recap: recommended model set, benchmarks, and sample prompt intake
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Muller <alex.muller@luminex.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: recommended model set, benchmarks, and sample prompt intake

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so you have a single place to refer to. Great discussion on Luminex's customer-facing doc summarization and triage workflows; main constraints you reiterated were: 1) sub-500ms median token latency for live chat, 2) strict PII redaction requirements for EU-origin data, and 3) need for deterministic quality on legal/finance documents.

What we recommend to start with (pilot phase):
- Model candidates: RW-3B-v1-quant8 (best latency/cost tradeoff, strong summarization), and RW-13B-v1 (higher quality for mixed-long documents; use for batch/eval jobs).
- Eval plan: run a 24-hour benchmark across both models on your representative corpus (we'll run on Dedicated pool) and compare Rouge/ROUGE-L for summaries + hallucination rate on the annotated prompt set.
- Prompt set: please send 200–500 representative customer prompts including edge cases (very short/very long, mixed-language, heavily redacted), and a handful of adversarial examples you worry about. We'll provide a redaction guidance checklist — see attached sample_prompt_template.md.

Links and attachments I included:
- Internal baseline benchmark: https://console.redwood.ai/benchmarks/luminex-discovery-2027
- sample_prompt_template.md (attachment) — formatting we prefer for eval ingest
- redwood_benchmark_v1.csv (attachment) — example output from a prior telco pilot for reference

Ask from you:
1) Drop the prompt CSV by end of week (luminex_sample_prompts.csv or similar).
2) Confirm acceptable data retention window for logs (we typically keep 30 days by default; can adjust).
3) Any must-pass quality thresholds (e.g., <5% hallucination on contracts) or regulatory constraints we should bake into the eval.

We'll queue a short benchmark job as soon as we get the sample prompts. Ben will scope the run and Grace will set up the eval metrics and dashboard.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
[Attachment: sample_prompt_template.md]
[Attachment: redwood_benchmark_v1.csv]

From: Alex Muller <alex.muller@luminex.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@luminex.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: recommended model set, benchmarks, and sample prompt intake

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear summary. Attaching an initial dump of ~120 prompts extracted from our chat logs and support tickets. You'll find columns for source type, expected label (summary/triage), and a flag for whether the sample includes customer PII. We redacted obvious identifiers but left realistic structure for the eval.

We can't share legal contracts in full yet; we can provide synthetic contract excerpts and a small set of redacted real contracts if needed (let us know required scope).

Retention: we prefer 90 days logs for troubleshooting but can accept 30 days if that helps scope the pilot.

We'll plan a short sync next Tuesday to review benchmark results.

Thanks — Alex

[Attachment: luminex_sample_prompts.csv]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Muller <alex.muller@luminex.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: recommended model set, benchmarks, and sample prompt intake

Thanks Alex — got the CSV and started a quick pass to spot obvious redaction gaps. A few quick notes: 

- We prefer the CSV to include a column called "redaction_level" with values (none/minimal/full) so our pipeline can run synthetic redactions prior to eval. If you can add that column it speeds ingestion.
- Edge-case asks: please include at least 20 examples that contain: nested quotes, email thread snippets, and mixed-language (EN/FR) segments. Those tend to be failure modes in summarization.
- Quality/regression guardrails: we'll configure automatic regression alerts tied to your canonical prompt set. Typical thresholds we recommend for legal workflows: F1-summary >= 0.78 and hallucination_rate <= 5%. We can tune these on the first pass.

I've created an eval workspace and will upload intermediate results here: https://app.redwood.ai/evals/DEAL-7845 — Jonas/Ben you'll see the baseline for RW-3B-v1-quant8 in the first run.

Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Product Lead, Model Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Muller <alex.muller@luminex.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: recommended model set, benchmarks, and sample prompt intake

Looping in timeline and infrastructure notes.

Plan:
- I'll spin a 24-hour Dedicated run on the RW-3B-v1-quant8 and RW-13B-v1 variants once we confirm final prompt CSV and retention window. Expect initial metrics (latency percentiles + basic Rouge scores) within 36 hours of job start.
- If Luminex wants longer retention for troubleshooting (90 days), we can enable it for the pilot; will need a short amendment to the pilot terms (I can draft).
- For compliance: do you require audit logs to be exported to your S3 account or is hosted log retention fine? Exporting to your S3 is straightforward but we'll need a one-time IAM role exchange.

I attached a quick config stub that I'll use to kick off the job — please review and flag anything missing.

Ben

[Attachment: quick-benchmark-job.json]

From: Alex Muller <alex.muller@luminex.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: recommended model set, benchmarks, and sample prompt intake

Ben/Grace/Jonas —

Thanks everyone. We updated the CSV to add the requested redaction_level column and added ~30 nested-quote examples. Attached is the redacted set labeled annotated_prompts_redacted.csv.

Retention: we'll accept 30 days for the pilot but would like to revisit 90 days for the production roll-out.

Audit logs: we prefer S3 export. I'll loop our infra lead on the IAM info in the calendar invite.

Next step: confirm a 30-min follow-up on Wednesday (10/06) at 11am PT — I'll send the invite.

Best — Alex

[Attachment: annotated_prompts_redacted.csv]
